fact: The Treasury Memorandum of March 2026 on the FY2023/24 audit reports that IFMS was re-engineered with a Fixed Assets Module and whole-of-government asset register, and describes e-Tax as an integrated tax administration system and IPPS as being replaced by HCM.
title: Treasury Memorandum on the Report of the Auditor General for the Financial Year 2023/24
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development
